Two large industrial units are visible, partially crated in wood and wrapped in plastic.
The machinery is painted blue and beige.
One unit appears to be a vertical heating oven, the other a blowing station.
A digital watermark 'MACO MACHINES' is overlaid on the images.
No manufacturer nameplates, model numbers, or control panels are visible.

risks.proof: Photos of all included components outside the container.
risks.if_unproven: as the blowing and heating units only
